# Daniel Heene's Personal Website

> Source for [daniel.heene.io](https://daniel.heene.io): a personal website, blog, and resume
> builder built on Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19) and Payload CMS 3.x, with MongoDB, Redis,
> and S3-compatible storage.

This is a code repository, not a documentation site — the files below are the entry points an
AI coding agent should read before making changes, not end-user docs. `AGENTS.md` is the most
important file: read it first, every time.

This file describes the repository. The website's own public `/llms.txt` is a separate thing,
generated from published content by `app/llms.txt/route.ts`.

## Start Here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Required reading before any change — stack, commands, code style,
  architecture notes, security guardrails (session checks on server actions, authenticated SSE
  channels, server-side SVG sanitizing, production detection via `PRODUCTION_HOST`) and known
  issues.
- [README.md](README.md): Setup and local development — Doppler-based env config, Docker
  services, available scripts, environment variables, project structure, testing, CI/deployment.

## Configuration

- [payload.config.ts](payload.config.ts): Payload CMS configuration (collections, globals,
  plugins, jobs queue, S3 storage, KV store, dashboard widgets) — repo root, not under `src/`.
- [next.config.ts](next.config.ts): Next.js configuration; validates the environment against
  the Zod schema at startup and owns the opt-in dev tunnel. There is no `env:` block: browser
  values are plain `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` variables.
- [proxy.ts](proxy.ts): Next.js 16 request proxy (the former `middleware.ts`); canonicalizes blog
  listing URLs and marks non-default sorts `noindex`.
- [src/types/environment.ts](src/types/environment.ts): Zod schema and source of truth for all
  environment variables.
- [.env.test](.env.test): The one committed env file — dummy, format-valid values for E2E runs
  and CI checks.
- [docker-compose.yml](docker-compose.yml): Local infrastructure (MongoDB, Redis, S3-compatible
  storage) — the app itself runs via `bun run dev`, not as a compose service.
- [package.json](package.json): Scripts and dependencies; Bun is the package manager, Node.js
  runs Next, Payload, the scripts and the tests.
- [oxlint.config.ts](oxlint.config.ts): Lint rules (Oxc toolchain, not ESLint), including the
  Tailwind plugin and the vendored `anti-slop` plugin.
- [oxfmt.config.ts](oxfmt.config.ts): Formatting and import order (not Prettier).
- [syncpack.config.mjs](syncpack.config.mjs): Dependency version rules, including the pinned
  Playwright version.
- [lefthook.yml](lefthook.yml): Git hooks — format and lint staged files, sync `package.json`,
  check the commit message.
- [commitlint.config.mjs](commitlint.config.mjs): Conventional Commits rules.
- [vitest.config.ts](vitest.config.ts): Unit test configuration.
- [vitest.setup.ts](vitest.setup.ts): Shared mocks (`payload`, `next/cache`, `server-only`,
  `redis`) and the forced `TZ=UTC`.
- [playwright.config.ts](playwright.config.ts): E2E test configuration (Chromium).

## Source Layout

- [app/](app): Next.js App Router — `(frontend)` for the public site, its route handlers
  (preview, sse, health, icons/collection, the blog RSS feed, the resume download) and
  `sitemap.ts`; `(payload)` for the admin panel and Payload's REST API; `llms.txt/` for the
  site's public `/llms.txt`; `robots.ts`, `manifest.ts` and `global-error.tsx`, which have to
  stay at the root of `app/`.
- [src/collections/](src/collections): Payload Collections (Media*, Pages, BlogPosts,
  BlogTopics, Resume*, Redirects, References, Users).
- [src/globals/](src/globals): Payload Globals (SiteSettings, SettingsGlobalUser,
  PDFGeneratorSettings).
- [src/blocks/](src/blocks): Reusable Payload Blocks (resume sections, content blocks).
- [src/fields/](src/fields): Reusable Payload field factories (`SlugField`, `TitleField`, ...).
- [src/components/](src/components): React components.
- [src/lib/](src/lib): Utilities grouped by domain, including `RedisHandler.ts` (cache and
  pub/sub for SSE), `isProductionHost.ts` (the only way to tell production apart) and `seed/`
  (fixture seed/clean logic shared by the CLI scripts and the admin panel).
- [src/lib/access/](src/lib/access): Access control functions — no role system; any
  authenticated Payload user is fully trusted.
- [src/lib/actions/](src/lib/actions): Server actions (`'use server'`) for admin mutations, and
  `requireSession.ts`, the session check every such action runs first.
- [src/lib/anthropic/](src/lib/anthropic): Claude calls (alt text, meta descriptions, blog
  excerpts, resume translation); all go through `generateAnthropicText.ts`, which owns the model
  IDs, effort, timeout and output limit.
- [src/lib/sse/](src/lib/sse): Allowlist of Server-Sent Events channels, public and
  authenticated.
- [src/jobs-queue/](src/jobs-queue): Payload Jobs Queue task/workflow configs plus their
  handlers (`handlers/`), which only the standalone worker runs.
- [src/plugins/](src/plugins): Local Payload plugins (redirects, references).
- [src/widgets/](src/widgets): Payload dashboard widgets (async server components registered in
  `payload.config.ts`; client parts call server actions from `src/lib/actions/`).
- [src/emails/](src/emails): React Email templates (contact form notifications).
- [src/pdf/](src/pdf): PDF generation for the resume export.
- [src/migrations/](src/migrations): Payload database migrations.
- [scripts/](scripts): Dev runner, worker entrypoint, env loader, seeders, image assembly.
- [e2e/](e2e): Playwright E2E specs — structural smoke tests, not content assertions.

## Build and Deployment

- [.github/workflows/lint-and-test.yml](.github/workflows/lint-and-test.yml): Pull-request gate —
  lint, Semgrep, unit tests (the E2E job is currently commented out).
- [.github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yml](.github/workflows/build-and-deploy.yml): Push
  pipeline for `main` and `develop` — version bump, migrate, build, image boot checks, push,
  Dokploy redeploy.
- [Dockerfile](Dockerfile): COPY-only images for the app, the worker and Storybook; everything
  is built in CI.
- [release.config.mjs](release.config.mjs): semantic-release — releases from `main`, release
  candidates from `develop`.
- [scripts/start-worker.mjs](scripts/start-worker.mjs): Worker container entrypoint; runs the
  job queue and its health endpoint.

## Optional

- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release history, written by semantic-release.
- [.storybook/](.storybook): Storybook configuration, component stories, and the
  design-foundation and shader documentation (MDX).
- [tools/oxlint/anti-slop/](tools/oxlint/anti-slop): Vendored Oxlint rule plugin.
- [patches/](patches): Dependency patches applied by Bun (`pdfjs-dist`).
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license.
